bonuses: If the clan already researched Amesha, skip straight to buying blueprints — 60,000 credits plus build materials, no research wait.

groups.activity: buy Nitain Extract with Nora Creds

rows.label: Nitain Extract
rows.note: 2 purchases; 2 per component research plus 4 for the final build

conditions: Nitain is untradeable and unaffected by any Resource Booster, Drop Chance Booster, blessing or Retriever mod.
Nightwave Creds expire when the season ends and convert to only 5,000 credits each — spend them before that.
bonuses: Check Twitch drops before grinding — one tracked case paid 75 Creds (12 Nitain) for 90 minutes of watching.

groups.meta: only 3 Tellurium needed; the build itself needs none

rows.label: Tellurium
rows.note: camp the flooded room; many players cover this from login rewards instead

conditions: Don't run a heat or corrosive weapon while playing Nekros — both destroy the corpse before Desecrate can roll it.
bonuses: A resource drop-chance booster helps the whole squad; resource quantity boosters are self-only. Nekros + Khora + a drop-chance booster reported 2-3 per five minutes, up to 10-12 in a single run.

disclosures.title: stale and current routes
disclosures.body: Hunhullus in Perita Rebellion dropped Tellurium as an unintended bug through Jan 2026 and was patched out. Corpus Railjack survivals (Luckless Expanse, Veil Proxima) and Scoria's Angel on Steel Path are the current alternatives some players prefer to Ophelia.

rows.label: Oxium
rows.note: Oxium Ospreys only; they drop nothing if they self-destruct instead of dying to a player

groups.activity: run the matching side; 3 rewarded per completion
conditions: Crafting one instead of running Invasions costs 15,000 credits, 10 ampules/samples, a Control Module and a 12-hour timer — Invasions are faster.

rows.label: Harness
rows.note: 15,000 cr, 2 Nitain, 900 Circuits, 3,600 Polymer Bundle, 5,500 Alloy Plate

rows.label: Systems
rows.note: 15,000 cr, 1 Control Module, 2 Nitain, 6,700 Salvage, 2,800 Circuits

rows.label: Wings
rows.note: 15,000 cr, 5,600 Alloy Plate, 5 Neurodes, 4,200 Polymer Bundle, 2 Nitain

rows.label: Amesha
rows.note: 25,000 cr, one of each component, 4 Nitain

conditions: The main blueprint is not tradeable, only the three components are — a warframe.market 'Amesha Set' selling components only cannot be built without clan lab access.
bonuses: Pairs naturally with the Mausolon — Voidrig hands that out for free, and it's the default archgun answer in almost every 'what archgun' thread.
